candidate_windows.window_text: Learning rate, epochs and batch size are set to $\{10^{-4}, 16, 1024\}$ and $\{10^{-5}, 5, 32\}$ for the QCS and CMO oracles, respectively. We ran a grid search only for the CMO baseline over the range $\{3e - 4, 1e - 4, 1e - 5, 1e - 6\} \times \{16, 32, 64, 128\}$ and 5 training epochs. We choose the best combination by monitoring accuracy on the validation set. We implemented our models in PyTorch (Paszke et al., 2019) and trained them on NVIDIA GTX 1080 Ti GPUs.
